ad10561569cc5b68.description: Sales Manager – Automotive Protection & Detailing BAY9 | Khurais Road, Exit 13, Riyadh | Full-time, on-site Compensation: Base salary plus sales commission BAY9 is a premium automotive protection and detailing studio opening in Riyadh. We’re looking for a hands-on Sales Manager to lead sales from day one and manage each customer’s experience from their first enquiry through vehicle handover. Key responsibilitie .Prepare quotations, follow up with customersand turn enquiries into confirmed bookings. * Help customers choose paint protection film (PPF), window tint, ceramic coating or detailing packages based on their vehicle, priorities and budget. Explain pricing, warranty terms and aftercare. * Confirm the scope of work with each customer and agree on a realistic delivery date with the installation team. * Keep customers informed throughout the job, review completed services at handover and follow up on any concerns. * Own monthly sales targets and report weekly on enquiries, bookings, revenue and conversion rates. Track why customers accept or decline quotations. * Build referral relationships with Riyadh dealerships, showrooms and automotive businesses, and encourage repeat bookings from existing customers. What we’re looking for * Experience selling automotive protection or detailing services, including at a dealership or specialist studio. * A track record of personally closing sales and meeting targets. Senior sales consultants ready for their first management role are welcome to apply. * Fluent Arabic and good English communication skills, both in person and on WhatsApp. * Strong follow-up and coordination skills, especially when managing several bookings and delivery commitments at once

ad20d01167df03bf.description: About Red Sea Global and AMAALA Yacht Club Red Sea Global (RSG) is developing the AMAALA Yacht Club, a premier destination located within the Triple Bay Marina on Saudi Arabia’s northwestern coast. This facility offers 120 berths for superyachts up to 130 meters, alongside a Marina Village designed for luxury and leisure. The AMAALA Yacht Club aligns with Vision 2030, focusing on sustainability and regenerative tourism by preserving natural habitats such as mangroves, seagrass, and corals. In 2027, AMAALA will host the Grand Finale of The Ocean Race, reinforcing its position as a global sailing destination. The Role of MEP Engineer Red Sea Global is seeking an Engineer - MEP to join the team at AMAALA Yacht Club. This full-time role involves routine inspections of building systems, identifying defects, and initiating corrective actions. The Engineer will also be responsible for inspecting and certifying the work of FM Service Providers and managing minor in-house projects. Key Responsibilities Conduct daily inspections of building systems and complete daily checklists. Raise work requests in the CAFM system for any anomalies detected. Monitor the progress of Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) and Corrective Maintenance (CM) to ensure adherence to agreed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Recommend timely purchases of critical spare parts and consumables. Perform monthly thermal scanning of equipment and the building envelope. Identify potential points of failure in HVAC/Mechanical systems or leaks in the building envelope and coordinate with the Civil Engineer for repairs. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience. Work Type This is a full-time position.

ad8041abc659b0dd.description: About SYSTRA SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA focuses on designing safe and sustainable transport solutions to connect people and facilitate access to employment, education, and leisure worldwide. For 65 years, the Group has supported cities and regions in developing, improving, and modernizing their infrastructure and transport systems across project lifecycles, from design to testing, deployment, and maintenance. SYSTRA operates in over 80 countries, with 74% of its turnover generated internationally, and supports clients in their digital, ecological, and energy transitions. The Role of Telecom Engineer (System) SYSTRA is seeking a Telecom Engineer (System) to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves performing design reviews for railway operational telecommunications systems to ensure adherence to project requirements and industry standards. The role requires 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Coordinate with internal and external technical disciplines to ensure successful integration of telecommunications systems within the overall project design. Coordinate assigned activities with contractors, utility providers, government authorities, and other stakeholders. Investigate field issues affecting property owners, contractors, and maintenance operations resulting from telecommunications and utility relocation activities. Review and approve telecommunications network relocation plans submitted by Design-Build contractors. Review and approve telecommunications design deliverables, including specifications, reports, schedules, drawings, and technical schematics. Review and verify detailed equipment and material requisitions proposed by contractors to ensure compliance with project requirements. Participate in internal and external coordination meetings, progress meetings, and design review workshops. Support the resolution of technical issues related to operational telecommunications systems and interfaces. Monitor design progress and provide recommendations to ensure successful project delivery. Required Skills and Experience Strong technical review, coordination, and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience is required for this position. Location This role is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

addda60d895e66f8.description: About the Role AECOM is seeking a detail-oriented and organized Inspector Architectural Finishes to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing the installation, quality assurance, and compliance of architectural finishes on construction projects. The successful candidate will work directly on-site to ensure all finishes meet specifications, building codes, and project requirements, while maintaining high standards of quality and safety. Key Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate the installation of architectural finishes, including paint, coatings, flooring, wall coverings, and specialty materials on construction sites. Conduct thorough inspections of materials, workmanship, and installations to verify compliance with project specifications and industry standards. Analyze technical drawings, specifications, and project documentation to ensure accurate implementation of architectural finishes. Identify and resolve on-site issues related to finishes installation, material compatibility, and quality concerns in a timely and efficient manner. Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, and project teams to ensure seamless execution of finishes work. Document daily activities, inspection results, and project progress through detailed reports and photographic evidence. Ensure adherence to safety protocols, environmental regulations, and local building codes throughout all project phases. Manage material inventory, verify deliveries, and maintain organized records of finishes specifications and certifications. Communicate project updates and technical recommendations to project managers and stakeholders. Troubleshoot technical challenges related to application methods, curing times, and environmental conditions. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a related field. Demonstrated ability to oversee architectural finishes installation and quality assurance. Proficiency in analyzing technical drawings and project documentation. Strong understanding of building codes, safety protocols, and environmental regulations. Work Environment and Company Culture This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. AECOM is a global infrastructure leader committed to delivering a better world. The company fosters a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration, and community, offering opportunities for growth and career development. AECOM is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Recruitment Process AECOM maintains a secure and trustworthy recruitment process. All newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

ad9189a71c684224.description: About the Role Talent Diamond is seeking a Human Resources Management Trainer on behalf of a prominent training center located in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves delivering practical training courses to a diverse audience, including aspiring HR professionals, current HR staff, managers, and business owners. Training Focus Areas The trainer will be responsible for covering a range of Human Resources Management topics. The curriculum is designed to provide practical skills and knowledge relevant to current workplace practices. Recruitment and selection processes Interviewing techniques Employee onboarding procedures HR administration and employee records management Performance management systems Employee relations Workforce planning strategies Learning and development initiatives HR reporting Specialized Expertise Candidates with specific expertise in certain areas are encouraged to highlight these in their application. This includes knowledge of HR analytics, Saudi workplace practices, or experience in preparing individuals for professional HR certifications. Required Qualifications and Experience Professional experience in Human Resources Strong subject matter knowledge in the proposed course topics Demonstrated ability to incorporate workplace case studies and practical exercises into training delivery Previous experience in training or coaching roles Recognized HR qualifications are preferred. Proficiency in both Arabic and English for training delivery is considered an advantage. Location and Availability This position is open to trainers globally. Applicants are requested to specify their current location, preferred delivery languages, and availability for in-person training in Jeddah, online delivery, or a combination of both.

adf9e56662a2c192.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة السحيمي للأساسات عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في سيهات، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان تطبيق لوائح السلامة والصحة المهنية ومتابعة بيئة العمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية في المنشآت. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل بشأن السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتسجيل النتائج ومقارنتها بالمعايير المعتمدة. تجهيز معدات وأجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز، وتوثيق النتائج ومتابعة معالجة الأخطار مع الجهات المختصة. تحضير مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات، وإجراء التحقيق وتوثيق النتائج. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتعليمات العمل الآمن والإخلاء، وتوعية العاملين بها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على تطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية ذات الصلة. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير والتوثيق. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الصحة والسلامة المهنية بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية في سيهات، المنطقة الشرقية، حيث يساهم في الحفاظ على بيئة عمل آمنة وصحية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور.

ad24411753eeed53.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking an IT Procurement & Vendor Management Analyst to support Digital Services (DS) in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This contract role involves managing and coordinating the end-to-end procurement lifecycle for IT services, applications, technology assets, and related operational requirements. The analyst will contribute to renewal strategies, commercial evaluations, vendor performance, and asset lifecycle planning to ensure value for money, financial accuracy, compliance, and service continuity. Key Responsibilities Coordinate DS procurement activities across various services, software applications, subscriptions, maintenance, and technology assets. Collaborate with service owners to consolidate requirements, plan procurement timelines, and prepare complete procurement requests and supporting documentation. Track purchase requests, purchase orders, contract milestones, approvals, and delivery commitments, proactively resolving bottlenecks and escalating risks. Support projects with procurement and financial documentation, ensuring alignment of contracts, approvals, and milestones with DS budgets. Maintain a forward-looking register of service, software, and support contract renewals, including expiry dates, costs, and usage. Support renewal and sourcing strategies by assessing demand, licensing needs, alternatives, consolidation opportunities, and service continuity risks. Coordinate with asset owners on procurement requirements arising from technology refresh, replacement cycles, warranties, and asset management plans. Analyze procurement spend, quotations, pricing structures, and contract terms to identify cost efficiencies and opportunities for improved value. Coordinate vendor engagement, monitor delivery and contractual performance, and follow up on commercial or service issues with responsible teams. Support competitive sourcing, vendor evaluations, and negotiations in coordination with the authorized Procurement function and DS stakeholders. Ensure procurement activities adhere to client policies, delegated authorities, contractual requirements, and documentation standards. Prepare procurement dashboards and reports covering commitments, renewals, savings opportunities, vendor performance, and outstanding actions. Identify gaps in procurement workflows, systems, and controls, recommending and implementing approved process improvements. Review supplier invoices against purchase orders, contracts, agreed pricing, delivery evidence, and service milestones to verify accuracy and resolve discrepancies. Coordinate with service owners, Finance, Procurement, and vendors to ensure timely invoice approvals, service entry confirmation, and payment processing. Track invoice status, outstanding commitments, and payment issues, maintaining reliable procurement-to-payment records and reporting. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in IT procurement and vendor management. The role requires a strong understanding of procurement processes, contract management, and financial accuracy within an IT context. Experience in identifying cost optimization opportunities and strengthening procurement and invoicing processes is essential. Collaboration and Communication The IT Procurement & Vendor Management Analyst will work closely with DS service managers, Finance, Procurement, and external suppliers. Effective communication and coordination skills are critical for resolving bottlenecks, managing vendor relationships, and ensuring timely approvals and payments. Location and Work Type This is a contract position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role requires on-site presence to effectively manage procurement activities and vendor relationships.

adcd89fae978726a.job_title: Executive Director Shared Services DMO (Mixed Use BU) Mixed Use BU (SPA )
adcd89fae978726a.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is developing a significant destination in Saudi Arabia, integrating entertainment, sports, culture, hospitality, residential, and mixed-use developments. This initiative requires robust development governance, integrated portfolio management, and executive oversight across a complex program of assets and projects. The Role of Executive Director - Shared Services DMO Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking an Executive Director – Shared Services to lead the Shared Services function across the Mixed Use portfolio. This full-time position, based in Riyadh Province, specifically Riyadh, involves providing executive oversight across governance, risk, integrated programming and performance reporting, budget and forecasting controls, financial administration, and payment oversight. The Executive Director will operate across the entire portfolio, ensuring Mixed Use leadership receives accurate, timely, and decision-ready information. This includes clear visibility of program performance, budgets, risks, dependencies, and required interventions. The role establishes a control, challenge, and assurance environment to enable development teams to progress efficiently through key approval, funding, and delivery gateways. Key Responsibilities Lead the Shared Services function for the Mixed Use portfolio, integrating governance, risk, program controls, reporting, budget management, and payment oversight. Establish and maintain a consolidated view of portfolio performance, including milestones, dependencies, budgets, forecasts, commitments, payments, risks, and issues. Lead Stage Gate readiness and governance processes, ensuring compliance with Delegation of Authority (DoA) and approval requirements. Oversee portfolio risk and control frameworks, identifying, mitigating, and escalating material risks and cross-development dependencies. Provide executive oversight of portfolio budgets, forecasts, commitments, accruals, expenditure, variances, and payment controls in collaboration with Finance. Deliver concise, forward-looking executive reporting that highlights emerging issues and required decisions or interventions. Collaborate with Development, Design, Delivery, Finance, Commercial, Procurement, and Risk functions to ensure consistent controls and governance across the Mixed Use portfolio. Provide challenge and assurance to individual development teams while maintaining clear accountability between portfolio controls and asset delivery. Lead and develop a multidisciplinary Shared Services team, promoting consistency, accountability, and continuous improvement. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Project Management, Finance, Business, Real Estate, or a related discipline. A minimum of 15 years of relevant senior leadership experience within large-scale real estate, mixed-use, infrastructure, or major capital development programs. Strong experience within a DMO, PMO, development management, program controls, or portfolio assurance environment. Demonstrable experience across governance, risk management, program controls, executive reporting, and budget/financial oversight. Strong understanding of Stage Gate governance, Delegation of Authority, portfolio controls, and executive decision-making processes. Strong financial and commercial acumen, with experience overseeing budgets, forecasts, commitments, accruals, variances, and payment controls. Proven ability to integrate program, financial, risk, and governance information into clear executive-level insights and recommendations. Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across Development, Finance, Commercial, Procurement, Design, and Delivery functions. Experience within major mixed-use, destination, or city-scale development environments is highly desirable. Professional qualifications such as PMP, PMI-RMP, AACE, RICS, APM, CIOB, or equivalent are advantageous. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic environment focused on large-scale development projects.

adea695926f273aa.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Captain Bellstand to join their team in Medina, Al Madinah. This full-time role involves providing comprehensive guest services, including assistance with luggage, transportation, and property information, while also serving as a departmental role model and supporting management functions. Key Responsibilities Greet guests and provide information on property amenities, services, hours of operation, and local areas of interest. Assist guests and visitors with entering and leaving the property, including opening doors and loading/unloading luggage from vehicles. Manage luggage storage and retrieval, and transport guest luggage to and from rooms or designated bell areas. Provide directions and arrange transportation services (*, taxi, shuttle, limousine) for guests, recording advance requests as needed. Dispatch bell staff or valet staff and communicate parking procedures to guests. Follow up with guests to ensure satisfaction with their requests or problem resolution. Serve as a departmental role model and assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues. Adhere to all company policies and procedures, reporting accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions. Maintain awareness of undesirable persons on property premises. Professional Conduct and Service Standards Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information. Welcome and acknowledge all guests, anticipate and address service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and express genuine appreciation. Communicate clearly and professionally, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Physical Requirements Ability to read and visually verify information in various formats. Capability to move at a speed required to respond to work situations (*, run, walk, jog). Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Capable of moving, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, and placing objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance, and objects exceeding 75 pounds with assistance. Proficiency in grasping, turning, and manipulating objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Ability to move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces, as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Capability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 year of relevant experience in a similar guest service role. The ability to perform the physical requirements of the role is essential. This is a full-time position. Application Information This role offers an opportunity to contribute to the guest experience at Sheraton Hotels & Resorts. Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry.

ad3742e47f8f7fc2.description: About the Role Hire Fellows is seeking a Marketing Specialist to join a student discounts and experiences platform. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 0-1 years of experience. The platform connects students with brands and universities, operating in Saudi Arabia and Oman, with plans for regional growth. Role Overview The Marketing Specialist will be responsible for expanding the student user base across Saudi Arabia. This involves managing digital campaigns, creating content, identifying new outreach methods, and converting ideas into measurable results. The role requires a proactive individual who can take initiative, execute quickly, and drive outcomes. Key Responsibilities Plan and execute marketing campaigns to attract new students and increase sign-ups. Manage and optimize paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, and Snapchat. Experiment with various content formats, target audiences, and campaign ideas to enhance performance. Organize and conduct university activations, engaging directly with students throughout Saudi Arabia. Coordinate with external agencies, content creators, and suppliers to facilitate marketing activities. Develop and maintain relationships with universities, student communities, and brand partners. Monitor campaign performance and identify strategies to improve student acquisition rates. Qualifications and Requirements Ability to independently manage campaigns and translate concepts into actionable results. A solid understanding of social media dynamics and the Saudi market. Proficiency in using AI tools for content creation and operational efficiency. An outgoing and proactive demeanor, comfortable with engaging people in the market. Resourceful, creative, and capable of working effectively within budget constraints. Willingness to travel across Saudi Arabia for marketing-related activities. Preferred Qualifications Experience in marketing a consumer application or digital platform. Prior experience in student marketing, university activations, or brand partnerships. Existing connections with universities, agencies, or creators within Saudi Arabia. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves direct engagement with students and partners across various locations in Saudi Arabia.

ad648198751d9ebb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة واثر للتطوير العقاري عن مهندس إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى وضع وتنفيذ خطط متكاملة للمشاريع، والتحكم في التغييرات، وتحديد نطاق المشروع بدقة من حيث البنود والأزمنة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع وتنفيذ خطط متكاملة لإدارة عدة مشاريع بالتزامن، وتحديد نطاق الأعمال والمراحل التنفيذية وإدارة التغييرات. متابعة الأعمال بالمواقع والإشراف على المقاولين، وضمان الالتزام بالمخططات والمواصفات الفنية وكود البناء السعودي ومتطلبات الجودة والسلامة. إدارة الفريق الهندسي وتوزيع المهام والمسؤوليات، ومتابعة الأداء وتطوير كفاءة العمل وتحقيق المستهدفات. إعداد ومتابعة البرامج الزمنية للمشاريع، وتحديد الموارد والمدد اللازمة للتنفيذ، ومعالجة التأخيرات لضمان الالتزام بمواعيد التسليم. إعداد ومراقبة الميزانيات والتكاليف بالتنسيق مع المختصين، وإدارة الموارد البشرية والمادية والمعدات، ومتابعة الإنفاق والحد من التجاوزات. مراجعة المخططات والمخرجات الهندسية، والتنسيق مع المكاتب الاستشارية والمصممين والمقاولين، ومعالجة التعارضات الفنية. تحديد المخاطر والتحديات الفنية والتشغيلية، ووضع الحلول والإجراءات التصحيحية واتخاذ القرارات ضمن الصلاحيات المعتمدة. تنظيم التواصل مع الجهات ذات العلاقة بالمشاريع، وضمان تبادل المعلومات ومتابعة الالتزامات والتنسيق بين الأطراف. إعداد التقارير الدورية عن نسب الإنجاز والتكاليف والمخاطر، ورفع التوصيات للإدارة التنفيذية وتوثيق مستندات المشاريع وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في إدارة المشاريع. القدرة على إعداد الجداول الزمنية باستخدام البرامج والتطبيقات المتخصصة. معرفة بإدارة التكلفة والموارد المطلوبة لإنجاز المشاريع. القدرة على توزيع المعلومات ونشر حالة مراحل المشروع. بيئة العمل يعمل مهندس إدارة المشاريع بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة، ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المشاريع بكفاءة وجودة عالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

ad377f4771c6bd0e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة مصدر النظافة للتجارة عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. يركز هذا الدور على تطوير وتحسين جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وضمان رضاهم من خلال تحديد مؤشرات الأداء ومعايير الجودة، وتحليل البيانات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة لوضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الجودة في خدمة العملاء، بالتنسيق مع إدارة الجودة، ومتابعة تطبيقها لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. المشاركة في وضع وتحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء، بما في ذلك تفاصيل الاتصال بهم واستلام طلباتهم واستفساراتهم والرد عليها بفعالية ومهنية، والتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية. تطوير برامج ومبادرات مبتكرة لضمان تجاوز توقعات واحتياجات المتعاملين فيما يتعلق بجودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، بهدف بناء نموذج متكامل لخدمة العملاء. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتحليل نتائج تقييم رضا العملاء، وتحديد الأنماط المتكررة للشكاوى والثغرات، ووضع خطط لمعالجتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بخدمة العملاء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم عميق لمؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الجودة في خدمة العملاء. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتحديد نقاط التحسين. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق والتنسيق مع الإدارات المختلفة. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في العمل. نوع الوظيفة وموقع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في بريدة، القصيم. يبحث عن مرشح ملتزم بتقديم خدمة عملاء متميزة وتطوير أنظمتها. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق مؤسسة مصدر النظافة للتجارة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

ad5bba3b42995f35.description: The Senior Director, Commercial Sustainability Planning is a senior leader responsible for maximizing the commercial value, resilience, and market competitiveness of Qiddiya's districts and assets through sustainability leadership. Acting at the intersection of sustainability, finance, policy, and development, the role aligns three critical perspectives: Saudi Arabia's sustainability ambitions and regulatory frameworks, international investor and sustainable finance requirements, and project delivery realities. The Director ensures that sustainability performance is measurable, credible, and aligned with recognized market frameworks, positioning Qiddiya assets to meet evolving investor expectations while delivering commercially viable outcomes. The role also provides environmental and sustainability oversight across districts throughout planning, design, delivery, and transition to operations. Strategic Leadership Lead Qiddiya's commercial sustainability planning strategy across districts, assets, and development programs. Position sustainability as a driver of asset value, investment attractiveness, resilience, and risk reduction. Provide strategic leadership on ESG, sustainable finance, and sustainability-related market trends. Support the development of sustainability policies, governance frameworks, and performance objectives aligned with corporate priorities. District Sustainability & Environmental Oversight Provide sustainability and environmental oversight across districts throughout planning, design, construction, and operational readiness. Ensure district sustainability objectives are embedded within project delivery, asset development, and operational planning. Monitor sustainability performance against approved targets, commitments, and frameworks. Guide project teams to balance sustainability ambition with cost, programme, technical, and operational considerations. Support the effective transfer of sustainability requirements into asset management and operations. At least 15 years' experience in sustainability, ESG, infrastructure, real estate, development, investment, or asset management. Experience delivering sustainability outcomes across large-scale mixed-use developments, cities, districts, or infrastructure programs. Demonstrated experience aligning project delivery with sustainability frameworks, investor expectations, and ESG reporting requirements. Experience within complex development environments, sovereign-backed projects, or emerging markets is highly desirable.

ad44074e9e342cdc.description: KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end-to-end services to take clients from inspiration through conceptualization to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities. As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 57th largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey. We invite you to join us. Why? When you join KEO, you ll discover more than just a job you ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company-wide health and well-being through on-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards, mentoring and coaching programs and extensive in-house on demand learning courses. Responsibilities Our newest opportunity is for a talented Senior Electrical Engineer to join our team based in Riyadh, KSA, The position is responsible for providing an independent technical review of electrical design submissions, including power distribution, lighting, low-current, fire alarm, and life safety systems, to ensure code compliance, technical adequacy, constructability, and multidisciplinary coordination. We envisage success in this role to include; Electrical Design Stage Reviews Review contractor electrical design submissions across Pre-Concept, Concept, Schematic, Detailed Design, and IFC stages. Review, revise, and approve load schedules, single-line diagrams, short-circuit calculations, voltage drop calculations, lighting calculations, and low-current system architectures. Conduct Peer Reviews when requested by the Client for electrical designs prepared by Client-appointed designers. Code & Regulatory Conformance Verify compliance with Saudi Electrical Code (SBC 401/801), SEC standards, SASO, NFPA and local authority regulations. Confirm that electrical rooms, substation spaces, cable tray routes, and panel locations satisfy spatial and maintenance requirements. Evaluate electrical system constructability, safety, and energy efficiency (lighting power density), recommend improvements. Integration, BIM & Stage Gate Approvals Coordinate electrical interfaces with mechanical (HVAC power/BMS), civil, structural, and architectural design leads. Participate in BIM clash detection to resolve containment, lighting, and equipment spatial conflicts. Support stage-gate approvals, risk tracking, and technical evaluation of electrical design modifications. Site Supervision & Technical Oversight Supervise site installation of electrical equipment, switchgear, transformers, generators, cable containment, lighting, and low-current systems. Ensure electrical works strictly comply with SEC standards, SBC 401/801, Saudi Civil Defense requirements, and licensing regulations. Provide technical support, resolve site coordination queries, and review drawing modifications. Submittals, Inspections & Testing/Commissioning Review and approve electrical shop drawings, material submittals, factory test reports, and method statements. Conduct site inspections, establish hold points, and witness field testing (insulation resistance, earthing, primary injection). Establish testing & commissioning schedules, overseeing testing and energization procedures alongside operator teams. BIM Integration, As-Builts & DLP Management Ensure electrical updates are integrated into the BIM model; review and approve model-extracted As-Built drawings. Review electrical O&M manuals, test dossiers, spare parts lists, and manufacturer warranties. Prepare electrical snagging lists, verify outstanding work completion, and supervise defect rectifications during DLP. Desired Candidate Profile Qualifications, Experience & Competencies Essential Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor s degree in electrical engineering from an accredited university. Experience Level: 12+ years recommended in electrical and low-current design and design review. Professional Registration: Registered with the Saudi Council of Engineers, or other relevant professional regulatory bodies, as applicable. Core Competencies Expertise in electrical design software (ETAP, Dialux, Revit MEP, Navisworks). Comprehensive knowledge of SEC guidelines, SBC 401, NFPA and SASO standards. Proficiency in power distribution, emergency standby systems, low-current systems (ICT, CCTV, Access Control), and fire alarm design. Strong analytical, inter-disciplinary coordination, and technical writing capabilities.

ad5744ceb60537d6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أورانجإكسيل عن طبيب نفسي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، بالمنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على تقييم وعلاج الأفراد الذين يواجهون تحديات عاطفية أو سلوكية أو نمائية أو اجتماعية. سيعمل الطبيب النفسي على مساعدة الأفراد على تطوير آليات التكيف وتحسين مهارات التواصل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى الطبيب النفسي مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لتقديم رعاية نفسية متكاملة، تشمل: إجراء التقييمات النفسية الشاملة لتحديد التحديات العاطفية والسلوكية. تصميم خطط التدخل العلاجية الفردية بناءً على أساليب قائمة على الأدلة مثل العلاج المعرفي السلوكي (CBT)، وتحليل السلوك التطبيقي (ABA)، والعلاج باللعب. تقديم الجلسات العلاجية لمساعدة الأفراد على بناء آليات للتكيف وتحسين مهارات التواصل. التعاون مع فرق متعددة التخصصات لضمان تقديم رعاية متكاملة وشاملة. استبدال السلوكيات غير التكيفية بأخرى إيجابية من خلال التدخلات العلاجية. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحين يتمتعون بالخبرات والمؤهلات التالية: خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال علم النفس أو العلاج السلوكي. فهم عميق للأساليب العلاجية القائمة على الأدلة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق متعدد التخصصات. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل الطبيب النفسي ضمن بيئة داعمة تهدف إلى تقديم أفضل رعاية نفسية. عن شركة أورانجإكسيل تلتزم شركة أورانجإكسيل بتقديم خدمات متخصصة في مجال الرعاية الصحية، وتسعى لتوظيف الكفاءات التي تساهم في تحقيق أهدافها في تحسين جودة حياة الأفراد. تقديم الطلبات نحن ندعو المرشحين المؤهلين والمهتمين للتقدم لهذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريقنا في شركة أورانجإكسيل.
